name: Animals
description: From a lion to the largest animal that has ever lived: how big animals really are next to a person.

name: Vehicles
description: Cars, buses, trucks, airliners and ships, drawn to scale so you can see how they measure up.

name: Buildings
description: Homes and skyscrapers compared at their true heights, from a family house to the tallest building in the world.

name: Structures
description: Towers, monuments, dams and sports fields: famous structures measured and drawn side by side.

name: Nature
description: The tallest trees, great waterfalls, the highest mountain and the deepest canyons, measured against familiar things.

name: Space
description: Rockets, the space station, the Moon and the planets, from 100 metres to thousands of kilometres across.
